text: SCH3858's behavior is flagged for review due to evidence that suggests an unusual increase in browsing to job-search sites, which is atypical for their role as a Security Guard. Specifically, their own recent typical behavior was 27.50 visits, but this week they visited job-search sites 45 times, with a z-score of 3.34 indicating a significant deviation from normalcy. This is even more pronounced compared to same-role peers, who averaged only 1 visit during the same period (z=29.68).
